senses.zh_definition: 拉凯什：源于印度语言传统的男性名字；在马来语文本中用作人名。
senses.en_definition: Rakesh, a masculine given name of Indian origin used as a personal name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada tradisi penamaan India.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不应解释成马来语普通词。未核实为 DBP 普通词条，因此 status 标为 proper_name；本马来文释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 引文。以下为人名称谓组合，不是固定词汇搭配。马来西亚官方人名实例见 [地方政府名录](https://mphtj.gov.my/index.php/ms/direktori/jabatan-penguatkuasaan-jpk/rakesh-a-l-morthy)。

etymology.historical_story: Rakesh belongs to an Indian naming tradition rooted in Sanskrit. Its historical components are rākā, referring to the full moon, and īśa, meaning lord or ruler, yielding the conventional interpretation “lord of the full moon.” In Malay usage it functions as a person's name; that historical interpretation is not an everyday Malay noun meaning. [Name etymology](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rakesh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Rakesh 当作通讯录里的一个完整名字来记；用“满月之主”的词源画面辅助联想，不把它当成马来语中“月亮”的说法。
